name: browserctrl
tagline: Which browser is that device id? Answered from disk, in one command.
description: Map Claude-in-Chrome device ids to the Chromium browser, profile and signed-in email behind them, see which profiles are open right now, and resolve a nickname like `work chrome` to an id in one command. CLI + Go library. Reads Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Arc and Chromium profile stores read-only: no browser flags, no network.

positioning.category: browser identity resolver for AI coding agents
positioning.audience: developers running Claude Code with several Chromium browsers or profiles open
positioning.wedge: the MCP only reports opaque device ids and unstable 'Browser N' labels, so picking the right window means clicking a confirmation prompt in every browser, every session
alternatives: reading chrome://version or the extension popup by hand
differentiators: answers from disk: extension LevelDB + Local State, no browser flags, no relaunch
knows which profiles are open right now via the LevelDB lock, and lists closed ones too
nickname to id: `browserctrl find legable` prints one id or a distinct exit code
read-only by construction: stores are snapshotted and opened read-only, the probe is a shared non-blocking flock
importable Go package plus a fixture package for tests, no browser needed
one list across Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Arc and Chromium
